scripts.lint: prettier --check package.json pnpm-workspace.yaml presetter.config.ts tooling && eslint --flag v10_config_lookup_from_file --format stylish --max-warnings 0 presetter.config.ts tooling && pnpm -r run lint
scripts.test: vitest run --passWithNoTests --configLoader runner --project='*:UNIT' && pnpm run test:tooling && pnpm --filter @antica/ui test && pnpm --filter @antica/mobile test
scripts.test:coverage: vitest run --passWithNoTests --configLoader runner --project='*:UNIT' --project='*:INT' --coverage --coverage.provider=istanbul --coverage.thresholds.perFile --coverage.thresholds.statements=100 --coverage.thresholds.branches=100 --coverage.thresholds.functions=100 --coverage.thresholds.lines=100 && pnpm --filter @antica/ui test:coverage && pnpm --filter @antica/mobile test:coverage
scripts.typecheck: pnpm run typecheck:tooling && pnpm --filter '!@antica/monorepo' -r run typecheck
